text:
sam_fin: Flagging a billing discrepancy for customer 'Northbridge' on invoice NB-1209. Looks like a pricing-experiment rate was applied to a production cohort for 2024-05-01 -> 2024-05-07, net overbill ~ $13,200. Need approvals for a manual adjustment + note to customer.

peter_ops: Can you paste the invoice lines and the experiment id?

sam_fin: Paste (redacted customer id):

```
Invoice NB-1209
Date: 2024-05-08
Line 7: usage-core prod (May 1-7) 3,300,000 tokens @ $0.006 = $19,800
Line 8: pricing-experiment XPR-2024-04-PR1 applied (cohort misrouted) -$6,600  <-- should not apply to prod customers
Net due: $13,200
Expected prod rate without experiment: 3,300,000 tokens @ $0.002 = $6,600
Should have been: $6,600
Overcharge: $6,600
```

zoe_pricing: Experiment XPR-2024-04-PR1 was supposed to target 'beta-trial' cohort only. Looks like the cohort filter omitted an account-level allowlist check. We're rolling a fix, but this affected 4 paid customers.

metering-bot: Alert: cohort-routing anomaly detected (id: cr-44f2). Matched 4 customers, total misapplied credit impact: $26,400. Suggested action: issue manual credits to affected customers and patch targeting filter.

elaine_sales: Northbridge contacted their AM asking why they saw a mid-month credit and then an odd subtotal. They assumed system error already fixed. Recommend we proactively issue a corrective credit and attach an explanation.

sam_fin: Proposed action for Northbridge: manual credit of $6,600 and credit memo CM-NB-202405-CORR. Also run an audit for the other 3 customers and prepare credits. Approve?

peter_ops: Approve issuing the $6,600 credit to avoid churn. I'll add a postmortem and deploy the cohort-fix (adding allowlist guard and a canary).

zoe_pricing: We'll also freeze experiment XPR-2024-04-PR1 and re-run the experiment in a staging bucket. I'll own follow-up analysis to compute net revenue impact.

metering-bot: Credit memo draft CM-NB-202405-CORR created (amount: $6,600). Queue FIN-2024-803 opened for bulk adjustments.

elsam_fin: (typo correction) sam_fin: I'll post the credit and attach ledger note: reason = pricing_experiment_misroute.

elaine_sales: I'll send partner message explaining: "We discovered an internal misconfiguration that temporarily applied an experiment rate to your account. We've issued a one-time corrective credit of $6,600 and sincerely apologize. No change to your contract or future pricing." Will share copy in the ticket.

sam_fin: Action items: finance post credit, sales send comms, ops patch filter + postmortem, pricing rerun experiment safely.

peter_ops: Patching now; adding an integration test to ensure allowlist is enforced. Deploy will go to canary env and then prod.

zoe_pricing: I will calculate cumulative experiment leakage and recommend whether to absorb or invoice vendor-funded experiments. So far impact: $26,400 across 4 accounts.

metering-bot: Actions logged: credit_created, patch_deploy_started, experiment_frozen.

sam_fin: Approved and moving forward. Will attach the final credit memo to FIN-2024-803 when posted and then close.

elaine_sales: Thanks team 44d will follow up with the customer thread once credit is visible.

sam_fin: Closing for now — reopen if customers request additional detail.
